answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 28245 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: If i go to masjid for asr namaaz and if i see that there are only few minutes left for the jamaat to begin then i have 2 options either to pray asr sunnah quickly or either pray tahiyyatul masjid normally so which one shall i select to pray before the namaaz? Question: If i go to masjid for asr namaaz and if i see that there are only few minutes left for the jamaat to begin then i have 2 options either to pray asr sunnah quickly or either pray tahiyyatul masjid normally so which one shall i select to pray before the namaaz? Answer ID: 28245 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 41/18/D=1432) If there is time of two or four rakah salah before starting of the jama’ah, you can offer two or four rakah (as per the time) with the intention of sunnah, it shall suffice for tahiyatul masjid. قال في النهر و ينوب عنها كل صلاة صلاها عندالدخول فرضا كانت أو سنة (شامي ج:1، ص:501) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
